Across authorized products (enforced via executor-bound views), the aggregation calculated the sum of item sale price minus current catalogue cost (`products.cost`) as a cost proxy, alongside total completed items, filtered by `status = 'Complete'` with no date filter applied [q1].

For the 14 completed items observed, the total sale price minus current catalogue cost proxy (`cost_proxy_margin`) was -280.0 [q1].

### Limitations

- Current catalogue cost represents a static reference proxy and does not reflect historical cost at transaction time or net profit.
